title: Capacity 1:1 — lightning agenda and follow-ups
notes:
Purpose: 15-minute prep for weekly 1:1 with Capacity Owner (Samir). Keep it focused: current runway, two risks, one ask, three quick metrics.

Context (30s): Q1 reserved pool is tight; burst usage spiked on March benchmark runs, autoscale policy didn't trigger because min-instances blocked by commit floor. Want to align on short runway mitigations and a sticky change to autoscale tiers for mid-tier customers.

Lightning agenda (15 min total)
- 00:00–00:90: Quick state (runway days, committed vs. available GPUs, recent spike summary)
- 01:30–05:00: Two risk hotspots (model onboarding backlog causing pinned capacity; cross-tenant noisy neighbors)
- 05:00–09:00: One ask (temporary soft-burst window + change to autoscale policy)
- 09:00–13:00: Quick decision matrix (go/no-go for soft-burst; throttle plan)
- 13:00–15:00: Assign action items and blockers check

Key numbers (for the opening minute):
- Committed GPUs (Q4 reserved): 480 GPUs (NVIDIA A100 equiv)
- Current active usage (30d avg): 412 GPUs
- Usable spare pool: 68 GPUs (after reserved buffer 10%)
- Predicted 30d demand if onboarding finishes: +120 GPUs
- Runway at current burn: ~18 days before hitting soft-reserve threshold

Two immediate risks to surface:
1) Onboarding surge risk: two enterprise customers finishing evaluation in the next 10–14 days. If both flip to prod, we need ~90 GPUs to meet initial traffic peaks. Graceful throttling plan required.
2) Autoscale blind spot: current min-instance floor set by reservation anchors prevents scale-down between experimental bursts, causing sustained higher baseline and reduced available spare. This magnifies peak impact.

Proposed ask (single ask):
- Approve a 14-day soft-burst window (policy: allow up to +50 GPUs for critical onboarding; billed to sales credit line; auto-revert) AND approve changing autoscale policy to tiered-burst mode (min-instance conditional on rolling-average utilization). Rationale: buys 2–3 weeks of runway and reduces false floor.

Decision matrix (fast):
- If approve both ask and tiered-burst: runway extends by estimated 21–28 days; implement immediately via patch to autoscaler config and manual allocation of hot spare pool (50 GPUs).
- If only soft-burst approved: runway extends by ~10–14 days but autoscale inefficiency remains — risk of repeated spikes.
- If neither approved: prepare throttling script and customer-negotiation playbook; escalate to director-level commit.

Quick blocker list (prep items to mention):
- Need signoff from finance for sales credit reserve (linked to ledger acct CC-POOL-12).
- SRE window for config deploy (need 30m with no rolling upgrades).
- Telemetry check: ensure KV cache eviction metrics are not suppressed by current sampling.

Action items (assigned, short):
- "Ava — draft customer messaging + credit structure for soft-burst (due 2024-11-14)"
- "Samir — run canary of tiered-burst autoscale on staging (50% traffic) and report results (due 2024-11-15)"
- "Ellen — confirm finance approval path and estimated credit exposure (due 2024-11-13)"
- "Tariq — create throttling script prototype (per-org qps caps) and runbook (due 2024-11-16)"
- "SRE oncall — reserve 30m deploy window next Tue and add to change calendar (due 2024-11-12)"
- "DX — prepare short billing FAQ for customers eligible for soft-burst (due 2024-11-15)"

Follow-ups to track (weekly):
- "Runway metric refresh (Ava) — publish updated numbers every Monday morning"
- "Post-canary telemetry review (Samir + SRE) — measure scale latency, failed allocs, and cost delta"
- "Customer conversion check (Sales) — status on the two enterprise evaluations"

Notes-to-self (loosely phrased):
- Keep ask focused: finance + autoscale change = minimal ops overhead and clear rollback. Avoid asking for permanent committed GPUs (hard sell).
- If finance balks, propose hybrid: small short-term commit (20 GPUs) + soft-burst for the rest.
- Remember to call out KV cache eviction impact — if cache warms are long, short spiky capacity won't help latency for 1–2 hours.

Meeting prep checklist (5 min):
- Pull last 7d allocation heatmap (infra/alloc/heatmap link)
- Confirm the two enterprise accounts and expected QPS (ask sales)
- Ensure staging canary is provisioned (Samir)
- Bring a one-slide cost delta table (Ava)

Tone for 1:1: pragmatic, limited asks, focused on reversible changes. Keep choice set to 2 (approve both / approve soft-burst only).

Endnotes: keep this doc as the canonical 1:1 prep for the next two weeks and move into shared drive if ask is approved.
